strokes.text: Manages one image source that is created directly inside a group, with its placement there.
It is the group counterpart of @resources/input.
Group resources need the native bridge plugin loaded in OBS; see @guides/groups.
Import by collection name, scene UUID, group UUID, group scene item ID, source UUID and child scene item ID, separated by pipe characters:

glazes.item_id: Scene item ID that OBS assigned to the placement inside the group.
glazes.name: Name of the source as shown in OBS. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.placement: Visibility, lock state, order and transform of the source inside the group. Positions are measured from the top-left corner of the group.
